description: This file defines the SelectedDisplayField class, an entity representing a selected display field related to reports in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for ID, display field, and report, with getter and setter methods. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and a decorator trait.

classes.name: SelectedDisplayField
classes.description: An entity class mapped to the ohrm_selected_display_field table, representing a field selected for display in a report, linking DisplayField and Report entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the selected display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the selected display field.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Associates a DisplayField entity with this selected display field.

methods.name: setReport
methods.description: Associates a Report entity with this selected display field.
